subject.title: Proposal: model-callable `clear_goal` tool with bounded canonical-store archive

question: Should OpenClaw allow a model-callable `clear_goal` tool to clear non-active session goals and retain cleared-goal history in canonical session state?
rationale: Current docs and code intentionally reserve clearing/replacement for operator/session controls, while this proposal changes model authority and adds retained session history semantics.

options.title: Keep operator-only clearing
options.body: Preserve the current `/goal clear`, `/new`, and `/reset` boundary and consider a non-destructive model request or operator-confirmed archive workflow later.

options.title: Approve terminal-only `clear_goal`
options.body: Allow a focused PR that clears only approved non-active states, writes bounded `SessionEntry.clearedGoals`, and updates mutation metadata, catalog, docs, tests, and live proof.

options.title: Approve a narrower state set
options.body: Permit model clearing only for `complete` and possibly `blocked`, leaving paused and limited states operator-controlled to reduce authority drift.

recommendation.title: Keep operator-only clearing
recommendation.body: Preserve the current `/goal clear`, `/new`, and `/reset` boundary and consider a non-destructive model request or operator-confirmed archive workflow later.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the core goal contract and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether the model-authority boundary should change.
